briefing.geography: The Salvage King's Claw rebuilt as a three-deck orbital yard, with a handhold spine between two drifting debris fields.
goals: Cross the salvaged Claw scaffold by its central spine.
Build across the carcass yard and both scaffold decks.
rules: Three surveyed decks divide the orbital yard.
Two debris fields flank the central spine.
Waves enter from the west and east.

buildables.meaning: Lights the dark and slows what it touches; radius 8wu.
Timber that holds. Bandits break it before you.
Works the river for you: 3g per cycle beside water.
Holds +150 gold above the pan cap.
Spark bolts, line-of-sight, 16wu range.
Write orders; the town's craftsmen answer. One per claim.

data.consequence: a lob that hits nothing re-enters after 12s on its original vector and may strike your own works; off the handhold spine and the scaffold decks thrust responds at half rate and momentum carries; the two debris bands slow the suit and chip it

rules: Three surveyed decks divide the orbital yard.
Two debris fields flank the central spine.
Waves enter from the west and east.

buildables.meaning: Lights the dark and slows what it touches; radius 8wu.
Timber that holds. Bandits break it before you.
Works the river for you: 3g per cycle beside water.
Holds +150 gold above the pan cap.
Spark bolts, line-of-sight, 16wu range.
Write orders; the town's craftsmen answer. One per claim.

data.consequence: a lob that hits nothing re-enters after 12s on its original vector and may strike your own works; off the handhold spine and the scaffold decks thrust responds at half rate and momentum carries; the two debris bands slow the suit and chip it

nextWave.compositionScope: wave-horn packs only; continuous tricklers are additional
